profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Skilled Software Engineer with experience developing software solutions across a wide
range of platforms, including embedded systems, firmware, and data engineering. Proficient in C,
C++, Python, and Java, with expertise in system integration, debugging, and performance
optimization. Adept at driving software development from design through to production, with a strong
focus on building scalable, efficient, and maintainable systems.

Proven success in leading complex projects involving SoC bring-up, bootloader development, and
cross-functional collaboration with hardware, firmware, and product teams. Strong ability to
troubleshoot and solve technical challenges, ensuring high-quality software and reliable system
performance.

positions.title: Systems Software Engineer - Platform Enablement
positions.description: Skills: C++ · Tableau · Linux · Computer Hardware · Github · Programming · macOS · Microsoft Office · Python · Xcode · Project Management · FPGA · iOS · JavaScript · Firmware · Data Analysis

positions.title: Embedded BringUp Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed to ROM development and specification for Apple M4 chip, integrating security features for secure boot.
Pre-Silicon bootloader development for M4 iPad Pro, focusing on chip initialization and system validation.
Designed and implemented visualization and logging tools for adaptive clocking, enhancing system performance and real-time debugging for hardware and software teams.
Assisted in database migration to Lua, optimizing system performance, and providing comprehensive documentation for smooth transitions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed a Java-based utility to extract telemetry data from Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), improving workflow efficiency and data analysis.
Spearheaded the collection of telemetry data to track the author/creator journey, providing valuable insights for debugging and process improvement.
Automated communication services to enhance release management, informing partners about releases and bug priorities.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux · Github · Programming · Microsoft Office · JavaScript · Data Analysis

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship (QGOV/Qualcomm Cyber Security)
positions.description:
Developed embedded clients for modem and DSP platforms, optimizing performance and reliability.
Applied existing interprocessor communication frameworks and adapted the hardware abstraction layer to support a new real-time operating system
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Linux · Github · Programming · Microsoft Office · Python · Firmware

positions.title: BIOS Security Research Internship (Software Services Group: Platform Security and Resiliency)
positions.description:
Contributed to the Excite BIOS Security Fuzzer, improving coverage and detection of vulnerabilities in EFI-based systems.
Developed a code coverage script to enhance the testing capabilities of the fuzzer, improving security assessments for BIOS systems.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Linux · Github · Programming · Microsoft Office · Firmware

positions.title: Service Center Supervisor
positions.description:
Supervise technicians and work with vendors to repair student and faculty systems
Troubleshoot Apple systems and resolve hardware and software issues Repair software and minor
hardware on PC computers
Work with students and staff to find them the best suitable computer for their academic needs
Help strategize and prepare for large technology sales and new product releases
Work with Faculty members and buyer to streamline product warehouse to customer process
Worked up from a Sales Associate, Lead Associate, Technician, Lead Technician
positions.insights: Skills: Customer Service · Microsoft Office · Project Management

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship (Core OS: Mac Platform Team)
positions.description:
Ported a new compression scheme to the Mac code base, improving performance for user-facing OS features.
Researched and applied compression algorithms to optimize system performance and data handling.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · C · Linux · Computer Hardware · Github · Programming · macOS · Microsoft Office · Xcode · Firmware

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship (Core OS: Mac Platform Team)
positions.description:
Developed an EFI-based verification system for Mac factory programming diagnostics,
ensuring correct chip configuration before device shipment.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Circuit Analysis · C · Linux · Computer Hardware · Github · Programming · macOS · Microsoft Office · Xcode · FPGA · Firmware

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description: Developed a cost efficient way to update visual medical device by creating software that made the user interface clear and intuitive while producing a rapid file-load response time. Utilized combination of Cygwin, C and C++ for user interface and programming of JTAG communication with hardware through PC USB port.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Circuit Analysis · C · Linux · Github · Programming · Analog Circuit Design · Microsoft Office · FPGA · Firmware
